journal_lines: A man with two llamas and something wrapped in cloth. §oSmelled like distance. Gave him a ration. Seemed fair.
Trader on a road that didn't go anywhere obvious. §oHis llamas smelled of many biomes. Traded. No regrets.
Strange stock in strange wrappings. Could not tell what any of it was from the outside. Bought one. Reasonable.
He spoke only to the llamas. The llamas seemed to consider it. §oGave up a meal's worth. Got something worth the meal.
The bell on his pack rang in no wind. §oHe noticed I noticed. Did not explain. Did not need to. Bought what he had.
Very far from any road, very far from anywhere — and there he was. Traded. The trade was good.
Gave him most of what I had on me. §oHis expression suggested this happened often. He gave back something better.
Met him at dusk, going a different direction than the road. Wrapped goods, fair price, done.
